blurb:
Turn downtown Nashville into a game. Drinkers & Thinkers is a guided bar crawl through Printer's Alley and Lower Broadway with a twist: at the final stop, the quiz drops. Timed, scored, and ranked against your group and the Nashville leaderboard, covering everything your host revealed along the way. The speakeasies that never respected Prohibition, the hauntings of Skull's Rainbow Room, who got banned from the Ryman stage. Pay attention. It is all on the quiz.

A bar crawl you play, not just walk: timed quiz, live scoring, Nashville leaderboard

Shot included at Alley Taps, in the heart of Printer's Alley

A route through downtown's most storied ground: the 1903 Arcade, Printer's Alley, and a Lower Broadway honky tonk finale

Shareable digital scorecard sent to your phone after the tour

Small group capped at 20 with a local host, not a 50-person herd

Ends in the middle of Lower Broadway, perfectly placed for the rest of your night
